## Adding a notebook

Put the notebook under `tutorials/`, add `metadata.zoomy` (`title`, `summary`, `tags`, optional `"status": "legacy"`) and run `python docs/scripts/generate_tutorial_index.py`.  Tag categories:

- `component:` model / system-model / numerical-system-model / solver
- `model:` swe / sme / vam / euler
- `task:` analysis / simulation / ad / coupling
- `backend:` jax / foam / amrex / numpy
- `method:` fv / lsq / mood / imex / chorin

To publish the rendered notebook in the book, add it to `PUBLISHED_TUTORIALS` in `docs/scripts/generate_ci_test_report.py` and to `_toc.yml`.
